headline: REA Gives Agents a Forensic Workbench
lede: REA turns reverse engineering into a structured agent workflow. It connects coding assistants and terminal tools to local analysis of binaries, apps, firmware, and packages, returning evidence, relationships, and explicit unknowns instead of opaque conclusions.

headline: AnyPS5 Rebuilds a Console’s Execution Path
lede: AnyPS5 translates PlayStation 5 executables toward native Linux and Windows environments rather than hiding them behind a conventional emulator. Relinking, PRX compatibility layers, and SPIR-V shader recompilation define a hard-edged interoperability experiment for preservationists and reverse engineers.

headline: ArtCraft Makes Generative Scenes Editable
lede: ArtCraft places image, video, audio, and 3D generation inside a visual production workspace. Artists can stage cameras, pose characters, composite assets, and shape scenes before choosing among multiple models, turning prompt experiments into repeatable compositions.

headline: Diagram Design Turns Prompts into Polished Systems Maps
lede: Diagram Design lays out a disciplined path from plain-language brief to standalone HTML and SVG. It selects from 44 diagram types, aligns elements to a grid, checks for collisions, and carries a site’s palette and typography into the finished artifact.

headline: God’s Eye View Maps a Moving Planet
lede: God’s Eye View gathers public flight, maritime, orbital, and camera feeds into a browser-based 3D globe. Its layered pipeline distinguishes live telemetry from reconstructed simulation while cockpit, FLIR, and night-vision views make sprawling movement legible.

headline: PyTorch Keeps Research Close to the Metal
lede: PyTorch pairs an imperative Python workflow with accelerated tensor computation and automatic differentiation. Its CUDA, ROCm, and Intel backends carry experiments from flexible debugging sessions toward production systems without sacrificing control over the underlying compute.

headline: AirLLM Streams Giant Models Through Small GPUs
lede: AirLLM makes oversized language models approachable by moving checkpoints layer by layer between storage, host memory, and the GPU. Quantization, prefetching, CPU and Apple Silicon support, and adapter training turn scarce VRAM into a measurable engineering constraint rather than an absolute barrier.

headline: Apollo 11’s Guidance Code Remains Readable
lede: The Apollo 11 repository preserves the Command and Lunar Module guidance programs as transcribed assembly, alongside scans, provenance, and revision history. Compilable through Virtual AGC tools, it offers a primary technical record of software built for navigation under severe memory and hardware limits.
